name: s
description: Plays samples or synths by name, one event per word of the mini-notation.

name: note
description: Sets the pitch of each event, with note names like c3 or eb2, or MIDI numbers.

name: n
description: Chooses a sample variant by number, or a scale degree when followed by scale().

name: bank
description: Plays the sounds from a drum machine bank: s("bd").bank("MotifKit") plays MotifKit_bd.

name: stack
description: Plays several patterns at the same time.

name: cat
description: Plays patterns one after the other, one pattern per cycle.

name: silence
description: A pattern without any event. Useful as a placeholder.

name: setcpm
description: Sets the tempo in cycles per minute. With 4 beats per cycle, setcpm(120/4) is 120 BPM.

name: setcps
description: Sets the tempo in cycles per second. setcps(0.5) plays one cycle every two seconds.

name: fast
description: Speeds the pattern up: fast(2) plays it twice per cycle.

name: slow
description: Slows the pattern down: slow(2) stretches it over two cycles.

name: rev
description: Plays each cycle backwards.

name: ply
description: Repeats every event inside its own time: ply(2) doubles each note.

name: early
description: Shifts the pattern earlier in time, by a fraction of a cycle.

name: late
description: Shifts the pattern later in time, by a fraction of a cycle.

name: hurry
description: Speeds the pattern up and raises the pitch of samples by the same factor.

name: iter
description: Starts the pattern one division later every cycle, so it rotates over n cycles.

name: euclid
description: Spreads a number of pulses as evenly as possible over a number of steps.

name: struct
description: Gives the pattern the rhythm of a pattern of x and ~.

name: mask
description: Silences the parts of the pattern where the mask is 0 or ~.

name: chop
description: Cuts each sample into equal parts and plays them in order.

name: striate
description: Cuts the samples into parts and interleaves the parts of every sample.

name: slice
description: Cuts the sample into equal slices and plays them in the order given by the index pattern.

name: loopAt
description: Changes the sample speed so it lasts the given number of cycles. The pitch changes with the speed.

name: begin
description: Starts sample playback at a position between 0 (start) and 1 (end).

name: end
description: Stops sample playback at a position between 0 (start) and 1 (end).

name: degradeBy
description: Removes events at random. degradeBy(0.3) drops about 30% of them.

name: degrade
description: Removes about half of the events at random.

name: sometimes
description: Applies a function to about half of the events, chosen at random.

name: often
description: Applies a function to about 75% of the events, chosen at random.

name: rarely
description: Applies a function to about 25% of the events, chosen at random.

name: lastOf
description: Applies a function on the last cycle of every group of n cycles.

name: firstOf
description: Applies a function on the first cycle of every group of n cycles.

name: chunk
description: Divides the cycle into parts and applies a function to one part per cycle, in turn.

name: jux
description: Plays the original pattern in the left ear and a transformed version in the right ear. An instant way to add stereo width.

name: juxBy
description: Like jux, with a width between 0 (both in the middle) and 1 (fully left and right).

name: pan
description: Places the sound between left (0), center (0.5) and right (1).

name: superimpose
description: Plays a transformed copy of the pattern on top of the original.

name: off
description: Adds a transformed copy of the pattern, shifted later by a fraction of a cycle.

name: scale
description: Turns the numbers of n() into notes of a scale, written as root:type, like C:minor.

name: transpose
description: Shifts notes up or down by a number of semitones.

name: arp
description: Plays the notes of each chord one at a time, in the order of the index pattern.

name: gain
description: Sets the volume. 1 is the default, 0 is silent.

name: velocity
description: Scales the volume of each event between 0 and 1, like how hard a key or pad is hit.

name: lpf
description: Low-pass filter: keeps the frequencies below the cutoff, in Hz. Lower values sound darker.

name: lpq
description: Resonance of the low-pass filter: higher values boost the cutoff frequency.

name: hpf
description: High-pass filter: keeps the frequencies above the cutoff, in Hz. Higher values sound thinner.

name: room
description: Adds reverb, between 0 and 1. The reverb is shared by all sounds of the same orbit.

name: size
description: Size of the reverb room: larger values give a longer tail. Also written roomsize.

name: delay
description: Adds echoes, between 0 and 1. The delay is shared by all sounds of the same orbit.

name: delaytime
description: Time between two echoes of the delay, in seconds.

name: delayfeedback
description: How much of each echo is fed back, between 0 and 1: more feedback, more repeats.

name: shape
description: Saturates the sound with waveshaping distortion, between 0 and 1.

name: crush
description: Reduces the bit depth, from 16 (clean) down to 1 (very harsh).

name: speed
description: Changes the playback speed of samples: 2 is an octave up, negative values play backwards.

name: attack
description: Time the sound takes to reach full volume, in seconds.

name: release
description: Time the sound takes to fade out after the note ends, in seconds.

name: sine
description: A signal that goes smoothly from 0 to 1 and back once per cycle. Use it as the value of a parameter.

name: perlin
description: A signal that wanders smoothly and randomly between 0 and 1.

name: range
description: Scales a signal from 0..1 to min..max, for example a filter sweep between 300 and 1200 Hz.
